Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = termid),
		success: Boolean = if CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() or
		term.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(term) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		term.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(term)
	postcondition:
		result = success
